answer: A reputation trellis lets trust grow only along verified work: each agent endorsement is weighted by the cost of the jobs it actually completed, so a Sybil farm cannot clone credibility for free. Like a lotus rooted in one pond, identity is anchored to a single stake of locked funds that is slashed on fraud, and new willow shoots of accounts start with zero weight until they earn it through attested deliveries. Cloning accounts multiplies mouths but not roots, so the attacker pays real work or real stake for every unit of influence.
